authoringNotes: These are lying-body spaces, not seated animations or passenger seats. No transform, collider or code change.
Level 2 is an additional price after level 1; cumulative total is derived, never charge the total again.
Sequential installation is proposed because ordering/unlocks were not specified. No new XP or district lock.
Data does not unlock Stage B or make a fourth NPC legal in the stock van.
No capacity above the confirmed maximum and no automatic money/XP multiplier.
For future integration: a failed installation must not consume the paid module; installation recovery and save binding remain open.
All levels and schemaVersion identifiers are structural. Capacity figures implement D5; only prices and procurement/installation policy are proposed.
